subject: Action Required: CloudScale Summit — AV contingency & speaker backup
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Action: Onsite AV contingency & speaker backup — CloudScale Summit

Team —

Two quick asks ahead of CloudScale Summit (Wednesday):

1) AV / power contingency: Booth island 12 (corner of Hall B). Venue confirmed standard 110V run, but we need a firm backup plan if power or network flakes. PeakAV is our primary contact — Chloe, can you confirm we have UPS units on site and a generator on call? I attached the floorplan and a one-page checklist.

2) Speaker coverage: Dr. Nina Shah is scheduled for 10:30am demo talk. We need a backup speaker and a plan to run the demo if she is delayed or can't present. Aisha — please confirm any customer-facing attendees we should prioritize for follow-ups if the session is impacted.

Please confirm by EOD tomorrow with who is owning each item.

Attachments: floorplan_v3.pdf, av_contingency_checklist.xlsx

Thanks,
Marissa

Marissa —

Confirmed with PeakAV (Tom cc'd). They will bring 3x UPS units rated for our booth, and a portable battery bank for the demo laptop. Generator is on-call (they have a vendor standby). I asked them to pre-stage a 4G failover router and two spare cellular hotspots.

I've added a short runbook to the checklist for swap-to-offline demos and for switching the live stream to a pre-recorded video if we lose internet.

I'll be onsite Wednesday 07:30 to oversee staging. Dev — can you validate the offline demo steps (see checklist)?

Hi all —

Confirmed: crew will bring 3x rack UPS (10min full-load hold), 2x battery banks for laptops, 1x 4G bonded router (we'll test bonding at load-in), and a technician will be assigned specifically to island 12 for the whole day. Generator vendor is on a 30-min callout if needed.

If Dr. Shah can't make the talk we can help by switching the booth TV to a recorded walkthrough and routing audio to the house PA. For the interactive demo we can provide an HDMI split and local switch to keep the display live while Dev falls back to a cached demo.

Onsite tech: Samir (mobile +1 510 555 0922).

Regards,
Tom Lee
Client Services, PeakAV
Attachments: None

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom@peakav.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: URGENT: Booth island 12 — power outage + speaker no-show (live incident)

Team — onsite now. Quick status and asks:

- At 10:08am the booth lost mains power. Two UPS units failed to hold under demo load (unexpected). PeakAV tech Samir is trying generator switchover; ETA ~25 mins.
- Venue network is down for Hall B (affecting our streaming and badge scan). PeakAV suggested immediate switch to their 4G router.
- Dr. Nina Shah did not arrive — we have a 10:30am slot starting in ~8 minutes with a handful of priority CloudScale attendees in the front row.

Immediate asks:
1) Dev — can you execute the offline demo from the Dell laptop (local cached model) and switch to HDMI 2 (Samir will handle the cable)? I attached the offline instructions.
2) Vivek — can you do a 10-minute impromptu Q&A intro to buy time and open with the product value props? We can run the recorded demo while we stabilize the demo environment.
3) Aisha — please flag the priority attendees (CloudScale) and start a short cover note offering a private follow-up if the session is interrupted.

I'll keep everyone updated. This is an incident and we'll need an incident report + remediation plan after the show.

Attachments: demo_offline_instructions.txt

-Marissa

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom@peakav.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 10:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: URGENT: Booth island 12 — power outage + speaker no-show (live incident)

On Wed, Mar 18, 2026 at 10:22 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Dev — can you execute the offline demo from the Dell laptop (local cached model) and switch to HDMI 2 (Samir will handle the cable)?

I am on it. Quick notes:
- Switched laptop to battery mode, started local server with the quantized model (cache preloaded). Performance target: 90% of the streamed demo for UI flows; some long-context prompts will be trimmed.
- Using PeakAV 4G bonded router for internet fallback; demo will run locally so only analytics are delayed.
- If the UPS cut power to the external display we can run the booth TV off PeakAV batteries for a 20–25 minute window.

I'll monitor the model logs and keep Marissa posted. If generator doesn't come up in 30 mins we'll prioritize recorded content + Q&A.

-Dev

Attachment: demo_offline_instructions.txt

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Tom Lee <tom@peakav.com>, Alyssa Gomez <alyssa@cloudscale.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-incident: CloudScale Summit — incident summary and next steps

Folks —

Summary of the day (short):
- 10:08am: Booth island 12 lost mains power. Two UPS units were insufficient under demo load; PeakAV initiated generator callout.
- 10:30–11:00am: Dr. Nina Shah did not attend; we ran an offline demo (Dev) and had Vivek step in for an impromptu Q&A. Recorded demo played on battery-powered display.
- Impact: Live stream and badge scans were intermittent. ~12 attendees from CloudScale were present for the slot; we offered private follow-ups.

Immediate remediation and actions:
1) Offer CloudScale a 20% credit on the pilot invoice and schedule a private onsite demo (Aisha to own).
2) Replace aging UPS units in our standard kit + add inventory check in the events playbook (Chloe + Procurement).
3) Formal incident report filed (attached). Laura — please advise on finance steps for the credit and how to route the invoice adjustment.
4) Engineering to document the offline demo runbook updates and keep a signed hardware checklist before load-in (Dev + Chloe).

I'll file a full RCA and a revised runbook by EOD Friday. Thanks to the onsite crew and PeakAV for the quick pivot.

Marissa Cole
Field Marketing Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: incident_report_20260318.pdf
